hypothesis: A separate single-element regime plus linear row, token, and padding costs explains the observations. The current measurements cannot distinguish a shape effect from first-call initialization.

pcvs.name: row_count
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-row traversal and conversion overhead.

pcvs.name: token_count
pcvs.rationale: Captures conversion of existing token IDs.

pcvs.expression: len(output_token_ids) * max((len(row) for row in output_token_ids), default=0)
pcvs.name: padded_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures tensor allocation and padding work.

pcvs.expression: int(len(output_token_ids) * max((len(row) for row in output_token_ids), default=0) == 1)
pcvs.name: single_element_tensor
pcvs.rationale: Separates the unusually costly single-element input observed in the report.
